title: Network CSV rerun destination policy integration
summary: Phase 6 integrates coordinator-owned destination policy for Network CSV rerun handoff outputs after Phase 5 reducer acceptance, with backend validation and representative real-media destination-policy evidence complete.
reason: Phase 5 can verify worker outputs and leave successful rows pending destination policy, but operators still need network CSV rerun results to flow into the same review, pending-publish, and final-output destinations as local CSV rerun without moving policy authority to workers or WebView.
behavior_before: Network CSV rerun rows can be reduced to worker_completed_pending_reduction with verified handoff output evidence, but final destination policy remains deferred and no row can be published, parked, or review-workspace materialized through network rerun state.
behavior_after: The coordinator can apply the configured Network CSV rerun destination policy to a verified handoff output with manifest-backed evidence, strict confirmations inherited from the preview/start contract, source/output safety checks, sidecar evidence preservation, duplicate destination guards, rollback evidence, and read-model status updates.
tests_added: tests.python.desktop.test_network_rerun_claims: coordinator-owned destination-policy outcomes for review workspace, Pending Publish, non-overlap final copy, confirmed final replacement, and fail-closed policy errors
tests.python.desktop.test_process_rerun_results: Network CSV rerun destination-policy read-model projection
manual_validation: PASS: Phase 6 real-media destination-policy validation using Phase 4B real worker output; evidence in docs/RealMediaValidationRuns/network-csv-rerun-phase6-2026-07-06.md
rollback_plan: Disable the Phase 6 destination-policy reducer entry point and leave accepted network rows in worker_completed_pending_reduction with their verified handoff outputs intact. Do not delete source media, handoff outputs, pending-publish payloads, review outputs, or final-library files during rollback; use row evidence to identify any partially applied destination action.
notes:
Phase 6 scope: coordinator-owned destination policy for Phase 5-accepted Network CSV rerun rows only. Workers remain forbidden from final library writes and Pending Publish ownership. WebView remains read-only/caller-only.
D1 distributed unit remains a single row. Apply destination policy per reduced row rather than waiting for an entire batch, because per-row idempotency and evidence make crash recovery smaller.
D2 batch/row state authority remains State/Rerun/Network/<batch_id>.json. Existing pending-publish manifests may be referenced as downstream evidence, but the network batch row remains the network rerun status authority.
D3 destination policy is coordinator-owned. Workers may produce handoff output only. WebView may request backend routes only and must not compute path, collision, pending-publish, or replacement decisions.
D4 source artifact remains the Phase 5 verified handoff output under <NetworkRerunHandoffRoot>/<batch_id>/<row_key>/. Destination action must never read from or mutate the original source path.
D5 safety proof must reuse preview/start destination decisions, Phase 5 source identity, final-output overlap checks, pending-publish duplicate guards, and source-overwrite confirmation evidence.
D6 lifecycle must be row-idempotent: duplicate apply attempts return prior evidence, partial moves remain recoverable, and active destination application keeps close-readiness unsafe until terminal evidence lands.
D7 result artifact model adds destination_policy_result evidence to each row, including action, inputs, outputs, manifest paths, sidecars, hash/size evidence, rollback/recovery data, and confirmation provenance.
D8 progress/read-model status remains backend-authored. Queue may render destination_applied, pending_publish, review_workspace, published, failed_policy, or policy_pending states from backend evidence only.
Validation rung: pending publish fixture tests, destination collision tests, sidecar carry-forward tests, source/output hash preservation tests, rerun results read-model tests, strict change-packet coverage, and representative real-media validation for clean replacement, pending-publish row, review-workspace row, failed row, and worker crash/retry row before Phase 6 is complete.
Stop conditions: stop if implementation would require worker writes to final destinations, WebView-authored policy decisions, broad SMB writes outside NetworkRerunHandoffRoot, source mutation, bypassing Pending Publish manifests, bypassing final-replacement confirmations, or weakening normal local CSV rerun destination semantics.
Backend implementation status: coordinator applies review workspace, Pending Publish, non-overlap final copy, confirmed final replacement, and fail-closed destination-policy failure states after accepted done reduction. Real-media destination-policy validation passed using the Phase 4B real worker output.
